name: Shibu's Art - Gifts & Resin Items
description: Established in 2019, Shibu's Art specializes in the design and creation of resin accessories and personalized gifting solutions. Our product range includes handcrafted resin clocks, bangles, earrings, and keychains. We offer specialized preservation services, allowing customers to encase and protect precious sentimental items within high-quality resin for long-term display. Every order is handled with a focus on customization; we create products based on specific user requirements and individual design preferences. With our years of experience in the resin industry, we provide durable, custom-made items tailored for both personal use and meaningful gifting. Give us an opportunity to serve you.

owner_posts.post_text:
Celebrate your baby’s beautiful journey from newborn to one year with a customized 12-month baby photo clock, a unique and meaningful keepsake specially designed to capture every precious milestone of your child’s first year. This personalized baby photo clock is not just a wall decoration—it is a timeless memory frame that tells the story of your baby’s growth month by month in the most artistic and heartfelt way.

Your baby’s first year passes so quickly. From their first smile to their first steps, every moment is magical and deserves to be remembered forever. Our custom first birthday photo clock allows you to preserve all those unforgettable memories in one elegant piece of art. Each clock is handcrafted with love and attention to detail, making it a perfect first birthday gift for baby boys and baby girls.

This handmade baby memory clock features your baby’s 12 monthly photos arranged beautifully around the dial, representing each special milestone from month one to month twelve. At the center of the clock, we can add your baby’s name, birth date, or a sweet message to make it even more special and personal. It becomes a one-of-a-kind treasure that families can cherish forever. 💛

If you are searching for a unique baby birthday gift, customized baby wall clock, or personalized keepsake for first birthday celebration, this photo clock is the perfect choice. It is ideal for parents who want something emotional, meaningful, and decorative at the same time.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text: This resin puja thali is absolutely beautiful and very thoughtfully designed. The color combination of red, pink and gold gives it a rich festive look, and the floral details with pearls make it feel really elegant. The use of rice in the base adds a lovely traditional touch that stands out nicely against the resin.The small separate spaces for keeping haldi and kumkum are very convenient and keep everything neat during puja. The reusable diyas are another big plus – they look pretty, sit perfectly on the thali, and are practical to clean and use again. Overall, this is a stunning and functional piece that really elevates the whole puja setup.

featured_reviews.review_text:

​Shibu is a phenomenal artist who truly listens. She took the time to understand my vision and delivered the piece perfectly on time. The fit and finish are exquisite—you can tell it is handcrafted from scratch with immense love. We started with a digital mockup for approval, and she even added thoughtful, minute details on her own that made the piece even more beautiful. If you are looking for soulful, personalized resin art, check out her Instagram (@shibus_art). Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Rafiya Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Would not recommend purchasing this product at all.

Yes, the cloth quality is decent, but that means absolutely nothing when the product itself fails to serve its purpose properly. The sizing/design clearly seems made only for people under 5 feet tall (I'm 5.5"), yet this was nowhere mentioned on the website before purchase. Important details are conveniently hidden while the brand aggressively advertises on Instagram just to push sales.

What makes this worse is that it’s a prepaid-only website, so the company gets your money upfront and then leaves you stranded when there’s an issue. The moment you raise a genuine concern, the response is basically: “our vendor is fixed,” which translates to — we got your money, now deal with it yourself. No refund, no exchange, no actual solution.

For the premium prices they charge, the greed is very obvious. The focus seems to be more on aggressive marketing and collecting payments than providing transparency, accountability, or proper customer support.

Buy only if you’re willing to risk wasting your money on an overpriced product and a company that disappears the moment you need help.

The pen is still visible in the product images, and I have screenshots of the original description showing it was included when I purchased. Very disappointing experience and poor customer service. I expected either the missing item to be sent or some accountability for the misleading listing.
